steps.en: Officer saves changes to an SMS or email template
steps.id: Officer menyimpan perubahan template SMS atau email

steps.en: Officer saves changes to a letter template
steps.why_en: Saving supports letters, but the screen cannot open a letter template.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan mendukung letter, tapi layar tidak bisa membuka template letter.

steps.en: Officer marks the change to take effect immediately
steps.why_en: There is no immediate-or-scheduled option; changes are simply stored on save.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pilihan segera atau terjadwal; perubahan langsung tersimpan saat disimpan.

steps.en: Officer sets a start date and time so the new template is scheduled
steps.id: Officer menentukan tanggal dan jam mulai berlaku sehingga template terjadwal
steps.why_en: No effective date field or storage exists, so a change cannot be scheduled.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada field atau penyimpanan tanggal berlaku, jadi perubahan tidak bisa dijadwalkan.

steps.en: The new template is used when sending, as the officer chose
steps.id: Template baru dipakai saat pengiriman sesuai pilihan officer
steps.why_en: The change reaches the database at once, but the sending job may keep the old text; no schedule exists.
steps.why_id: Perubahan masuk database seketika, tapi job pengiriman bisa tetap memakai teks lama; tidak ada jadwal.
